nom: Vacation Shake Shake SPF 50 Mineral Milk Face Sunscreen

avis.texte: This sunscreen blends in really well and sits great under makeup. It smells great and is lightweight for a mineral sunscreen. It runs a bit on the dewy side so if i wear by itself I tap on a pressed powder on my t-zone.

avis.titre: Couldn't even try it because of the scent
avis.texte: I was excited to try this because I love mineral sunscreens for my face, and I thought it might be like a cheaper option for the Shiseido Urban Environment sunscreen. However, when I opened it, the smell of the sunscreen was so strong that it made my eyes water. It also wasn't sealed like the regular Vacation face & body sunscreens, which was disappointing. I like knowing that the other sunscreens haven't been tampered with when I purchase them. Sorry Ulta, this one is going back.
Pros: doesnt burn my sensitive skin and does provide sun protection Cons: I feel very oily all day until I remove it and there is a white cast.

Committed to wearing daily sunscreen but prefer mineral and always struggle to find one that doesn't have a white cast/isn't weirdly tinted. This is perfect. It does look white at first but as you rub it in it virtually disappears. It also feels really hydrating.

I'm happy with this product. It applies to the skin well, leaves a glow, isn't too heavy, and works with makeup. The nostalgic bottle is both fun and comforting. Thank you for making old stuff great again
I've been searching for a sunscreen with ample protection, no chalkiness, and skin benefits built in. This must be my 3/4th bottle, and I love the results!

So far, love this sunscreen. Its not greasy at all. It sits beautifully under makeup and doesnt make your makeup patchy or runny. The scent is a bit strong, but petsonally I dont mind it. A little goes a long way.
Shake shake is the best little friend for picky, sensitive skin!

I wanted to like this product. I really did. The perfect texture, the cute retro packaging, it's cruelty-free... but I cannot get past the SMELL. This stuff absolutely reeks, enough to make me nauseous, which is not typical for me.

avis.titre: Vacation is what I take on my vacation!
avis.texte: Love the products. I buy them from my HSA store and for my kids and for me! I love the shake shake

The texture is lovely and is wears beautifully on the skin but the cucumber smell lasts way too long and gives me a headache. As a frequent migraine sufferer I can't recommend this to anyone who is sensitive to smells. Would 100% buy a fragrance free version if they released it!

As someone with dry, sensitive, pale skin who is paranoid about getting burnt - this is the answer to all my needs! It feels and smells good, although it is pretty pungent. I love that it's just Zinc, and its a high enough concentration to do something. This type of lightweight sunscreen is perfect to reapply all day. Although it is technically greasy, it leaves more of a nice glow than the grease that most Zinc-only sunscreens have. It is very expensive, but the quality is worth it and the bottle lasts a lot longer than you might think, I have been using it every day for 4 months (multiple applications a day, nickel sized portions) and I still have probably 1/4 of the bottle left. My only complaint is that after getting through half the bottle, the applicator has started to be a tiny bit leaky, although it is manageable when I am careful to clean it off.

avis.titre: I really wish they'd make a fragrance free option.
avis.texte: I love everything about this sunscreen but the fragrance makes it unusable for me. This would definitely be a staple for me if it weren't for the scent. So if strong fragrance doesnt bug you then you should try it out. Please make a fragrance free option ;_;

I received this as a freebie in a previous order recently finished and looking into buying another sunscreen but im honestly going to actually purchase this instead 🩵it surprisingly didn't peel and didn't irritate my skin!! Love it so much

This is an amazing mineral sunscreen! It is so fun to apply, and easy too! It doesn't take much effort like other mineral sunscreens and leaves no white cast on me. I also love the packaging! Because this sunscreen is so lightweight, this package keeps it easy to use and mess free! Received as part of an educational promotion.I also really like that this is reef safe. While I found myself using this as a part of my daily beauty routine, I will definitely use this when I am at the beach or going snorkeling in the barrier reef near to me. It is very important to me that I am not wearing sunscreens that are likely to harm the reefs so I love that this one does not contain any of those harmful sunscreen chemicals (in fact it does not contain any sunscreen chemicals as it uses minerals). This is also so fun to use. It is really a unique packaging that makes it very easy, but I also couldn't get over how fun it is! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Easy to apply, fast absorbing mineral sunscreen
avis.texte: This mineral sunscreen milk from Vacation SPF 50 is a great find. The texture is very lightweight and fluid, easy to shake and apply evenly on the skin. It absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky feeling, greasy residue, or white cast, which is impressive for a mineral sunscreen. The skin feels comfortable, hydrated, and looks fresh even in hot weather. The broad spectrum SPF 50 provides reliable protection against both UVA and UVB rays, making it perfect for daily use. It does not clog pores or cause irritation and works well under makeup. The 50 ml size is convenient and travel-friendly, easy to keep in a bag or take on trips. A great option for anyone looking for effective sun protection with a comfortable, elegant finish. Very gentle on skin. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I received this product as part of an educational program review, and I'm so glad I had the chance to test it out. I really like how lightweight and liquidy this sunscreen is. The consistency truly looks like milk, which makes it so easy to apply. It blends in perfectly and doesn't leave any white hue on my skin, which is a big plus for me. I also love the size and the bottle design. It's compact, spill friendly, and easy to throw in my bag for daily errands or on the go use.It wears really well under makeup and doesn't pill at all with my concealer and blush on. My skin feels hydrated throughout the day. I haven't tested it under a super hot and sunny day yet, but I did notice that I needed to reapply after my HIIT workout session, which is expected with heavy sweating.The only downside I'd mention is the strong sunscreen scent. It doesn't personally bother me, but I can see how it might be an issue for people who are sensitive to fragrance. I think for the price point and the product you get, it's a great lightweight mineral sunscreen that feels comfortable and looks good on the skin. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: White cast on my melanated skin
avis.texte: This Shake Shake SPF 50 mineral milk broad spectrum facial sunscreen by Vacation has such a nice, milky consistency to it, it glides on very well to the face and leaves a really nice healthy sheen. But with that being said, I think that this sunscreen product would work well with women or those with lighter and fairer skin tones. Even though it has a nice sheen and milky texture, it left a white cast to my face, and I have a darker skin complexion than others might not have. I wanted to love this so badly but it has a white cast on my darker skin. The sheen is beautiful but it couldn't be rubbed in well enough. I think this is better suited towards fair skin and I'm confident that those with fairer skin will get good use out of this sunscreen product! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Vacation Shake Shake SPF 50 Mineral Face Sunscreen
avis.texte: The Vacation Shake Shake SPF 50 Mineral Milk Face Sunscreen is a mineral sunscreen with a unique packaging. I love the design on the packaging because it reminds me of vintage designs. The flip spout makes it easy to dispense. The shakerball packaging helps mix up the non-nano zinc into a watery, milky texture that is lightweight and easy to apply. Because of the fluid texture, this sunscreen applies easily and works well as a daily sunscreen. This sunscreen offers broad-spectrum SPF 50 protection and is full of skin loving ingredients like hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and more. It feels hydrating without being overly greasy (great for dry, winter months!).One thing to note is that this sunscreen leaves a slight white cast. However, it's not as bad as some other mineral sunscreen. It blends in well if you have fair to light-medium skin tone. If you have a deeper skintone, the white cast will be more noticeable. Overall, this is a decent mineral face sunscreen that feels lightweight and comfortable all day. If you have lighter skincare and don't mind the white cast, this sunscreen will work well for you! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I was really excited to try this mineral sunscreen from vacation. The packaging is so retro and unique. It contains a little ball in the bottle to help mix the product when you shake it, hence the name! You do need to shake before using as the formula does separate. After shaking you flip the dispenser, which again is a unique part of the packaging. It is very easy to dispense onto the skin. Since it's a mineral sunscreen it does take a little time to rub into your skin. The sunscreen does not leave a white cast on my but I am light/medium skin tone. I do wish it didn't have a scent as it is very strong. I am not sure if it's from the white tea or cucumber but it's a bit overwhelming for me. I have dry sensitive skin and this didn't irritate my face which I appreciate. Overall it's a good summer sunscreen. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using the Vacation Inc. Shake Shake SPF 50 Mineral Milk for a few days now and overall I really like it. I take my SPF very seriously and I reapply multiple times a day. l have tried a lot of different sunscreens over the years and strongly prefer mineral sunscreen over chemical. I'm pretty picky when it comes to sunscreens but one thing I really love about this one is that it doesn't leave a white cast like most mineral sunscreens do.That alone makes want to use it, especially on days when I'm not wearing a lot of makeup and don't want to look chalky or washed out. It layers well, feels very lightweight on the skin, and doesn't clog my pores or feel greasy whatsoever. That being said, I did take a point away because it is very watery. You really have to shake it well and be careful when pouring it out or it can make a mess and run everywhere. I personally prefer a slightly thicker texture so it's easier to apply and I feel like I'm getting the most protection.Even with that small downside I still think it's a great mineral sunscreen and l'll definitely continue to use it. If you want something that protects well without leaving a white cast, this is definitely worth trying. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using the Vacation Shake Shake SPF 50 Mineral Milk Face Sunscreen and overall I really like it. First of all, I love the packaging…it's super cute and very compact, which makes it easy to throw in a bag. The applicator is one of my favorite parts. You just push up the little pink piece and the product comes right out of a small opening, so it's not messy at all and easy to control how much you use.The formula itself is very runny (I attached a video from a live photo), but honestly I don't mind that because it makes it easier to rub in and spread evenly across my face. The texture is really silky and smooth, and I love that it doesn't leave a white cast at all. I'm oily and acne-prone, and I haven't had any breakouts while using this, which is a huge plus for me. It also feels comfortable on my skin when I'm outside in the Florida sun.That said, I don't love the oily finish. It still feels nice on my face, but I can tell that once summer hits and it gets hotter, it might feel a little odd on very oily days. Since it's January, I'm not 100% sure yet, but it's something to note. I will say the more it settles the less oily it becomes, but still has an oily finish if that makes sense. There's no strong scent either… it's very subtle, which I appreciate.Overall, I really do love this product. I'd give it a 4 out of 5 stars, with the only point taken off because of the oily finish. Everything else about it I genuinely enjoy. **This review was collected as part of a promo

avis.titre: Lightweight mineral SPF that feels great on skin
avis.texte: I've been testing the Shake Shake SPF 50 Mineral Milk for about a week and really enjoyed my experience with it. The texture is lightweight and fluid, making it easy to apply and spread evenly on the skin. It absorbs quickly and feels comfortable without leaving a greasy or heavy finish.I appreciate that this is a mineral sunscreen with broad-spectrum SPF 50 protection, which makes it suitable for daily wear. It layers nicely under makeup and does not pill or feel thick throughout the day. I also didn't notice a strong white cast on my skin, which is a big plus for a mineral formula.Overall, this sunscreen feels gentle, wearable, and effective, and I would recommend it to anyone looking for a lightweight mineral SPF option.It feels like a great everyday sunscreen option that works well for normal to combination skin types and daily routines. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'd never heard of Vacation brand before this so I wasn't sure what to expect. I was pleasantly surprised with this spf facial sunscreen. You just have to make sure you give it a pretty good shake each time you use it. It has a nice light fragrance that is just right for my liking. Smells like something that could be unisex. The spf lotion spread on my face pretty easily. I've had other brands where the zinc oxide looks terribly white on your face. I also liked that it didn't leave a greasy or oily feel on my face and forehead. The bottle is a nice size for traveling or just taking it with you to and from work. I also liked that it feels like a luxury brand so that was pretty cool. Overall I like this stuff a lot and I'd definitely get it in the future. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using the Vacation Shake Shake SPF 50 Mineral Milk for a few weeks now, and it's become part of my daily routine. I've always had a hard time finding a mineral sunscreen that feels good on my face. Most are either too thick, leave a noticeable white cast, or feel like they just sit on top of my skin. This one is different. The first thing you notice is the bottle, you actually shake it before applying. It sounds a little quirky, but it serves a real purpose. After a few shakes, the sunscreen turns into a lightweight, milky liquid that spreads easily across the skin. It goes on smoothly, blends in quickly, and doesn't leave streaks or that powdery residue mineral sunscreens are known for. What I appreciate most is how it feels throughout the day. It's lightweight, not greasy, and doesn't make my skin feel suffocated. I have sensitive skin, and I haven't experienced any irritation or breakouts. It also sits nicely under makeup, which is a big plus for everyday wear. Another thing I like is that it doesn't just feel like sun protection, it feels like skincare. My skin stays hydrated, and the formula doesn't dry me out like some mineral sunscreens can. It's the kind of product I can put on in the morning and not think about again until I reapply! Overall, it's a reliable, easy-to-use face sunscreen that makes daily SPF feel simple instead of like a chore. I'm glad I tried it, and I'd repurchase it :) **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have tried many different sunscreens throughout my life, and I have come to find, that for my face, I really enjoy a thinner-serum-like mineral sunscreen for when I wear it under makeup, and this one is so great for that!It's spf 50, which I prefer, as I don't want to damage my skin! You can still get a bit of a tan even with such high factor, it just takes a little longer, and won't cause damage to your skin, as lower ones or even wearing none could do! The key to keeping your skin safe and prevent aging is to wear sunscreen everyday! I really like this brand vacations sunscreens (I have tried the mousse one before and it's great, I had tried other mousse ones way before that when I lived in Europe, but I believe this one is the only one I've found in the US). I will definitely continue to use this brand and this particular shake shake one!Another thing I like about the brand is the retro packaging! So fun and different. The scent of the products are also so good. It's not too strong or the typical sunscreen scent. To me it comes across as a little bit floral, which I like! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Loved packaging... don't love the scent
avis.texte: I loved this product's packaging. Retro! I also appreciate that mineral sunscreen can be applied and not leave a white cast! It's milky texture doesn't clog pores. The bummer for me is the scent. Hard to explain but it almost has an herbal smell. Not that pleasant though. It's a combination of medicine and old flowers. To me the scent lingers and it is hard to get past. I have looked for mineral products as I think they make a difference on fair skin. I think mineral sunscreen offers better protection. I was hoping to fall in love with this. If it were fragrance free, I would repurchase! What is also important is you really must SHAKE it thoroughly before applying. Then let dry and apply your make up. Overall good product for most people. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I hate to say I really disliked this sunscreen. The only thing I like about the Vacation Shake Shake SPF 50 Mineral Milk Face Sunscreen is the packaging. The texture is definitely milky and I would even say silky but I think it feels very thick on my skin and it did not blend well. I felt like it left a white cast on my face. I think the scent is heavy and somewhat obnoxious. I would not want to smell it for long periods of time. This product is not for me. The packaging also says to use a waterproof sunscreen if swimming or sweating, while I'm glad for the warning but I'm not interested in something that is not multi purpose. The shaker in the packaging worked well, I felt like my product was mixed and dispensed easily. I would not use this sunscreen in the future and I would not recommend it to others. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'm always on the lookout for a good mineral sunscreen. Since my eczema doesn't play well with avobenzone (common chemical sunscreen filter used in the US), finding good mineral sunscreens is a necessity. And Shake Shake isn't just a good mineral sunscreen, it's a great mineral sunscreen! It contains 20.5% non-nano zinc oxide which delivers broad spectrum SPF 50 against harmful UVA and UVB rays. Shake Shake's formulation is so nicely balanced. The 20.5% non-nano zinc oxide is not dry or chalky like some mineral sunscreens thanks to shea oil and hyaluronic acid. Then there are ceramides and collagen peptides to help strengthen the skin barrier, and cucumber, white tea, and aloe vera to help calm and soothe. All of that is mixed up by the shakerball inside, ensuring a thin and lightweight texture that feels creamy and hydrating when applied. And the finish is gorgeous, giving just a hint of dewiness. This one is a keeper! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I absolutely loved this sunscreen and it was so different than any sunscreen I've ever used before. I'm used to very thick feeling sunscreens but the fact this was a milky feeling sunscreen was completely different and so refreshing when applying it. I tend to be on the dryer side and this really refreshes and rehydrates my face when sometimes sunscreens tend to dry out skin depending on certain ones. I also think this sunscreen smells very good and I am big on my skincare products smelling good. I'm excited to use this sunscreen all summer long and see how it will wear under makeup in the hot hot heat. I would purchase this sunscreen and will definitely be adding this to my daily routine as it has certainly become a new staple in my every day routine. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

the bottle feels just right in my hand, easy to grab and hold it. It's easy to shake and pour from the spout but my only complaint is that the opening is a little bit wide. Since the sunscreen is quite runny, I sometimes end up pouring out more than I need, and it can get a bit messy. I wish the nozzle was a bit narrower.The scent is kind of like green bananas to me. It's fresh and mild, I don't mind it at all.As for texture, it's very lightweight and spreads easily. Once it's on, there's zero white residual. I also love that it's a physical sunscreen that has zinc oxide as it feels gentle on my skin. And when I wash off with a gentle cleanser. it comes off easily without any residue. And when I need to reapply sunscreen over my makeup, this one is watery enough that I can gently pat a little on top without completely ruining my foundation and my look. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I honestly didn't want to like this sunscreen - the formula was thinner and more of a runny liquid than I typically prefer, it felt oily upon application, and it had a stronger scent than I prefer. However! I was pleasantly surprised by how much I ended up enjoying this sunscreen. It applied nicely to my skin and while yes it was a bit oily at first, it really melted into my skin nicely and provided a nice base for makeup that wasn't greasy and didn't pill. The scent faded and wasn't noticeable a little while after application. It layered nicely with liquid skin tint, gel products, and powders. The packaging is also nice, the little spout makes application relatively mess-free, and it's a decent amount of product. It leaves behind a temporary white cast on my pale skin that does go away as the product absorbs, but I'm not sure how it would perform on darker skin tones. This product was received as a part of an educational promotion. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Vacation's line of sunscreens are quickly becoming my favorites for their variety of applications and formulas. This particular shake style one is in the cutest flip top bottle with a shaker ball inside to help mix the ingredients. One shaken, the product comes out in a thin, milky substance that has a light warm, aquatic floral type smell. It absorbs easily and quickly into the skin without any unflattering white cast left behind. It is moisturizing without being greasy, which I feel like a lot of facial sunscreens are unable to achieve. This shake formula will be my go-to sunscreen for my face and Vacation's wonderful Chardonnay Oil being my first choice for the body. They make the most beautifully applying and neat streak free sunscreens. Another hit by this brand! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This product is really nice overall - I subtracted a star because I'm not crazy about the slight scent. I love that it's mineral, but the scent and a few other ingredients make it a little more tox than I normally aim for. I can smell it on my face and hands after putting it on for a while. The packaging is so cute. The mineral milk is thin texture and leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. It doesn't look greasy or shiny. I'll be able to wear it daily and it looks nice under makeup as well. I'd love to see this in a spray version, i feel it's already thin enough for it. Overall I would recommend this product to anyone looking for a lightweight sunscreen for daily use. I am glad that I was able to test this product in exchange for my honest review. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'm conflicted over the Shake Shake SPF 50 Mineral Milk. The milky texture of the sunscreen is amazing. It goes on smooth and feels lightweight, which is important because I don't like my face feeling heavy with product. The application process is seamless and leaves a hydrated satin finish. I like that it has good skincare ingredients for dry skin like hyaluronic acid, squalane, ceramides, and polypeptide. I love Vacations branding that is beachy and nostalgic. The packaging is so cute. But the smell really bothered me. It has a strong floral chemically scent that's almost like bathroom cleaner. The odor does lessen as the day goes on. Overall I like it a lot and I'll save it for sunny days where I'm outside a lot and not for everyday use because of the smell. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I am a firm believer in using sunscreen daily before applying my makeup. I recently had the chance to try the Vacation Shake Skake SPF Mineral Milk and I have to say I am completely sold on this product. I completely love how this sunscreen feels on my skin. It has an amazing scent to top it all off as well. Keep in mind it is a little more liquified that most sunscreens so it does come out of the bottle quite quickly. I love its more watery consistency because it applies so much better to my skin than most sunscreens. Of course, it is considered a mineral milk, so milky instead of watery is a better description. Love love love this product and look forward to keeping it as a part of my current and future beauty regimen. It is a must-try. Remember, proteting your skin is important so why not find a great product like Vacation. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Vacation knows how to do sunscreen!
avis.texte: I have been using this sunscreen for about 2 weeks so far and have really enjoyed it. I am not the biggest fan of sunscreen, it is my least favorite thing I have to do for my skin so finding a sunscreen that works for me and makes me not feel icky is important: this sunscreen has been very nice, it's lightweight, actually absorbs into my skin, and provides good hydration. It really feels like I'm putting on a milky toner when using this, and I love milky toners, it gives a subtle glow when im wearing it by itself which is what I have been doing most days because I don't wear makeup that often. I did try it out with my usual makeup routine though and it laid down really good for me, didn't make me feel greasy and didn't make any of my product pill. I don't like in a place where it's hot any sunny right now so I can't speak to how well it blocks sun and keeps from getting sunburned but I have used vacation products before so I bet it will work just fine! The only thing I think could be improved is the smell but it doesn't linger and I think with sunscreens you're always going to have a weird smell. I definitely reclined this product and will definitely keep using it. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

At first I was a little dubious of this product — I've tried serum sunscreens, but nothing that was in a mineral milk form. Vacation's Shake Shake sunscreen is definitely pretty light in consistency when you first pour it out, and that honestly scared me a bit too! But once I applied it and saw how well it sank into my skin, I became an instant fan.I'm a bit of a dry skinned gal, and I've even found that I don't necessarily have to wear any moisturizer under this product. It provides plenty of hydration all on its own!I like how it gives a subtle glow to my skin, without any pigments or shimmers needed. I don't have any issues layering cream or powder makeup products over it, and have found that everything blends out easily!All in all, I'm super pleased with this product — it'll defs be my go-to SPF through the summer!This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review ️ **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Let me start out saying I take sunscreen seriously. Daily wearer who has tried out many and doesn't care for most. For the last week I've worn the Vacation Shake Shake SPF 50 mineral milk everyday and let me tell you I really like this stuff and in general I'm not a fan of mineral sunscreen because I find them to be heavy and greasy. This mineral milk was so lightweight and left no cast at all. Has a very light tropical almost melon-like scent which I found very pleasant. When you first apply the product it is white, which allows you to see where has had coverage which is great, once it's been rubbed in it goes clear. I did wear it both with and without makeup over top. When worn alone there is no white cast. When worn under makeup I did allow it a few minutes to dry down before applying anything else. It paired well with my other products, no pilling or anything weird. Also I really love the retro vibe style and the unique bottle. The applicator is super precise but the formula is thin, milk like, so I wouldn't be gentle squeezing until you get a feel for it. I really love this product, the silky feel, the lovely scent, cute retro bottle, awesome sunscreen . I received this product in exchange for my honest review. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: New addition to my everyday routine!!
avis.texte: For starters, I really like the application of this product. It goes on smoothly without leaving a shiny film on your face. This is a problem I have with other sunscreens especially if I layer makeup on top of it. I wore this product every day for a week to work. On top of it I put a tinted moisturizer (way too dry in my area to wear foundation). It lasted for my normal 10 hour shift and beyond on the days I got stuck late. I never used a mineral sunscreen before nor have I used this product before but o definitely would purchase it, as well as other products in the future. It also did not make me breakout which is something else I worry about when I try new sunscreens and sweat in them. Heck I even worked out with it on and I didn't have a problem. Would definitely reccomend! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This Shake Shake SPF50 Mineral Milk by Vacation is a broad spectrum SPF facial sunscreen.It is a small bottle, so perfect for throwing in your purse for reapplication. The bottle contains a ball to shake up and mix all the ingredients. Once shaken, the fluid comes out quickly and is a thin fluid that applies smoothly. I found it didn't leave a white cast on my pale skin.It leaves a satin finish once it has been thoroughly rubbed in. I liked how it felt on my skin after applying, no shine or glossiness.I really like the scent of this. It contains white tea, aloe vera, cucumber and cottonseed oil.This is perfect for daily use and is light enough that it doesn't feel heavy or clarty on your skin.This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using this SPF 50 mineral milk for a while now, and I'm genuinely impressed. First off, I love the shake-to-activate formula—it makes the texture super lightweight and easy to spread. Unlike many mineral sunscreens, this one doesn't feel thick or chalky, and it blends into my skin much more smoothly than expected.It feels comfortable on the skin, not greasy or heavy, and it layers well under makeup without pilling. I also appreciate that it doesn't leave my face feeling dry or tight after applying. It gives a natural finish that looks great for everyday wear, especially on no-makeup days.The packaging is compact and travel-friendly, which makes it perfect for tossing in a bag for reapplication. Overall, this is a solid mineral sunscreen that offers great protection while still feeling light and wearable. I'll definitely keep this in my rotation, especially for warmer months and outdoor days. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I am a daily retinal user so consequently need to use SPF every day. I was very impressed with this shake shake milk mineral sunscreen as it held up to its claims! I was able to use it every day without irritation and no negative impact on my make up or skin care products. There is a very faint scent when first applying but not like traditional sunscreen smells nor chemically, but it dissipated quickly. The texture of the product is milky like the name indicates and absorbs pretty quickly without visible residue, at least in my experience. I did want to note that the bottle explicitly states if you will be in the water to use a water proof SPF so this is not the product for swimming. I am very excited to continue to use this product and to try other products made by Vacation. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I honestly think this is the easiest and most pleasant sunscreen I have ever applied. I can only use mineral sunscreens, but don't love how they are sometimes difficult to rub in fully and leave a cast, but this shaker milky method is super different and convenient. The texture is definitely milky but I think it feels very thick on my skin and it does not blend well. I think the scent is heavy and somewhat obnoxious. This product is not for me.

avis.titre: I like it but the smell is bad
avis.texte: I like the milky texture and it melts into the skin easily. Its hydrating and left a satin finish to my face. The smell is so strong and overbearing when you first apply it but it goes away over time. Product was received as part of an educational promotion.

Vacation's line of sunscreens are quickly becoming my favorites for their variety of applications and formulas. This particular shake style one is in the cutest flip top bottle with a shaker ball inside to help mix the ingredients. One shaken, the product comes out in a thin, milky substance that has a light warm, aquatic floral type smell. It absorbs easily and quickly into the skin without any unflattering white cast left behind. It is moisturizing without being greasy, which I feel like a lot of facial sunscreens are unable to achieve. This shake formula will be my go-to sunscreen for my face and Vacation's wonderful Chardonnay Oil being my first choice for the body. Another hit by this brand! This product was received for free in exchange for research purposes and honest review.

I honestly didn't want to like this sunscreen - the formula was thinner and more of a runny liquid than I typically prefer, it felt oily upon application, and it had a stronger scent than I prefer. However! I was pleasantly surprised by how much I ended up enjoying this sunscreen. It applied nicely to my skin and while yes it was a bit oily at first, it really melted into my skin nicely and provided a nice base for makeup that wasn't greasy and didn't pill. It layered nicely with liquid skin tint, gel products, and powders. The packaging is also nice, the little spout makes application relatively mess-free, and it's a decent amount of product. It leaves behind a temporary white cast on my pale skin that does go away as the product absorbs, but I'm not sure how it would perform on darker skin tones. This product was received as a part of an educational promotion.

This product is really nice overall - I subtracted a star because I'm not crazy about the slight scent. The packaging is so cute. The mineral milk is thin texture and leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. It doesn't look greasy or shiny. I'd love to see this in a spray version

avis.titre: New addition to my everyday routine!
avis.texte: For starters, I really like the application of this product. It goes on smoothly without leaving a shiny film on your face. This is a problem I have with other sunscreens especially if I layer makeup on top of it. I wore this product every day for a week to work. On top of it I put a tinted moisturizer (way too dry in my area to wear foundation). It lasted for my normal 10 hour shift and beyond on the days I got stuck late. I never used a mineral sunscreen before nor have I used this product before but o definitely would purchase it, as well as other products in the future. It also did not make me breakout which is something else I worry about when I try new sunscreens and sweat in them. Heck I even worked out with it on and I didn't have a problem. Would definitely reccomend!

received as a part of an educational promotion. I've been using the Shake Shake SPF 50 Mineral Milk Face Sunscreen for a one week, and overall, I really like it. The SPF 50 protection feels solid and reliable, which gives me confidence for daily sun exposure and outdoor activities. Being mineral-based, it's gentle on my sensitive skin, non-comedogenic, and doesn't cause irritation. It absorbs quickly, leaves no white cast, and works well under makeup. The downside is the texture—it's very liquid, so I have to shake it thoroughly and apply carefully to avoid dripping. Despite that, it keeps my skin hydrated and protected throughout the day. I'm giving it 4 stars because a slightly thicker consistency would make application easier, but it's still a great daily sunscreen that I'd repurchase for its lightweight feel and effective sun protection

At first I was a little dubious of this product — I've tried serum sunscreens, but nothing that was in a mineral milk form. Vacation's Shake Shake sunscreen is definitely pretty light in consistency when you first pour it out, and that honestly scared me a bit too! But once I applied it and saw how well it sank into my skin, I became an instant fan. I'm a bit of a dry skinned gal, and I've even found that I don't necessarily have to wear any moisturizer under this product. It provides plenty of hydration all on its own! I like how it gives a subtle glow to my skin, without any pigments or shimmers needed. I don't have any issues layering cream or powder makeup products over it, and have found that everything blends out easily! All in all, I'm super pleased with this product — it'll defs be my go-to SPF through the summer! This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review ❤️

avis.titre: Vacation knows how to do sunscreen!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for anout 2 weeks so i have been able to try it in a few different ways. I have really enjoued it and i al bery picky about sunscreen, its my least favorite thing i have to do in my day to day routine. This suncreen though has felt very good, it is lightweight, absorbs well and doesnt have the full suncreen smell alot of brands do. You can obviously tell its sunsceen but i have not been dreading putting it on everyday like i do with most othwr sunscreens. I love the formula, its almost like putting a milky toner on, and i love milky toners. I have worn it alone and with makeup, i dont wear makeup everyday, like once week and it worked great under my makeup, it didmt male me feel oiky or make any of ky makeuo pill so that is always a plus. When wearing it by itself it left a subtle glow that i loved. I am not in a hot climate right now with a lot of sun so i cant speak on its sunblocking ability but knowing this is from Vacation i bet it will work perfectly. I definitely recommend this product and look forward to continueing to use it.

I've been using this SPF 50 mineral milk for a while now, and I'm genuinely impressed. First off, I love the shake-to-activate formula—it makes the texture super lightweight and easy to spread. Unlike many mineral sunscreens, this one doesn't feel thick or chalky, and it blends into my skin much more smoothly than expected. It feels comfortable on the skin, not greasy or heavy, and it layers well under makeup without pilling. I also appreciate that it doesn't leave my face feeling dry or tight after applying. It gives a natural finish that looks great for everyday wear, especially on no-makeup days. The packaging is compact and travel-friendly, which makes it perfect for tossing in a bag for reapplication. Overall, this is a solid mineral sunscreen that offers great protection while still feeling light and wearable. I'll definitely keep this in my rotation, especially for warmer months and outdoor days.

Let me start out saying I take sunscreen seriously. Daily wearer who has tried out many and doesn't care for most. For the last week I've worn the Vacation Shake Shake SPF 50 mineral milk everyday and let me tell you I really like this stuff and in general I'm not a fan of mineral sunscreen because I find them to be heavy and greasy. This mineral milk was so lightweight and left no cast at all. Has a very light tropical almost melon-like scent which I found very pleasant. When you first apply the product it is white, which allows you to see where has had coverage which is great, once it's been rubbed in it goes clear. I did wear it both with and without makeup over top. When worn alone there is no white cast. When worn under makeup I did allow it a few minutes to dry down before applying anything else. It paired well with my other products, no pilling or anything weird. Also I really love the retro vibe style and the unique bottle. The applicator is super precise but the formula is thin, milk like, so I wouldn't be gentle squeezing until you get a feel for it. I really love this product, the silky feel, the lovely scent, cute retro bottle, awesome sunscreen 👏. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

I am a daily retinal user so consequently need to use SPF every day. I was very impressed with this shake shake milk mineral sunscreen as it held up to its claims! I was able to use it every day without irritation and no negative impact on my make up or skin care products. There is a very faint scent when first applying but not like traditional sunscreen smells nor chemically, but it dissipated quickly. The texture of the product is milky like the name indicates and absorbs pretty quickly without visible residue, at least in my experience. I did want to note that the bottle explicitly states if you will be in the water to use a water proof SPF so this is not the product for swimming. I am very excited to continue to use this product and to try other products made by Vacation.

I honestly think this is the easiest and most pleasant sunscreen I have ever applied. I can only use mineral sunscreens, but don't love how they are sometimes difficult to rub in fully and leave a cast, but this shaker milky method is super different and convenient. I am fair skinned, so others may have another experience, but it took two seconds to rub in the sunscreen and it has very little white cast, then once it fully absorbed it was totally clear. It dried really soft and gives my skin a beautiful, naturally dewy glow. I struggle with dry, eczema prone-skin so I mixed a little moisturizer with the sunscreen when I rubbed it in, and it didn't feel drying in the slightest! My skin is also pretty sensitive and this didn't make me itch or inflamed, which is also why I prefer to use mineral sunscreens since they're more sensitive skin friendly. One more thing, the scent was kinda pleasant. It wasn't an overpowering smell of that typical sunscreen scent, it had some of that but it also smelled kinda fresh and citrusy almost? It's nice. Overall, I really do enjoy this product and would recommend highly!! This review was collected as part of a promotion*

This Shake Shake SPF50 Mineral Milk by Vacation is a broad spectrum SPF facial sunscreen. It is a small bottle, so perfect for throwing in your purse for reapplication. The bottle contains a ball to shake up and mix all the ingredients. Once shaken, the fluid comes out quickly and is a thin fluid that applies smoothly. I found it didn't leave a white cast on my pale skin. It leaves a satin finish once it has been thoroughly rubbed in. I liked how it felt on my skin after applying, no shine or glossiness. I really like the scent of this. It contains white tea, aloe vera, cucumber and cottonseed oil. This is perfect for daily use and is light enough that it doesn't feel heavy or clarty on your skin. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review

I was so excited to try this new mineral sunscreen. I really love the brand and the whole vibe of the product, very fun and energetic! The sunscreen itself surprised me. It was much more runny than expected. I appreciated how light the product was and it did not leave me feeling greasy, but the product's texture was too thin in my opinion. Overall it's a good choice for facial sunscreen, and I would consider using again. "I received as a part of an educational promotion."

This lotion feels light and smooth on the skin. It absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy feeling. My skin feels soft, hydrated, and fresh after use. It has a pleasant scent and works well for daily moisturizing. I would recommend this lotion to my friends.

I really liked this sunscreen. It feels very light on the skin and doesn't feel greasy at all. It blends in easily and doesn't leave a white cast. My skin feels comfortable and hydrated after applying it. I also love that it's mineral and SPF 50, so I feel well protected. Great for everyday use and under makeup. I will definitely buy it again. Received as a part of an educational promotion.

When they say shake shake they mean shake shake shake! You must shake this sunscreen, or it will be very thin and runny. This is a milky mineral sunscreen so be careful when you are pouring it out. The milky consistency is really the product's best part. It makes is so easy to apply and the lightweight formula just sinks right into your skin. It also works well with makeup and has many skincare ingredients like my favorite moisturizer, squalane. This product is perfect for my everyday sunscreen because it feels so smooth and light on my skin. I have combination skin so sometimes sunscreen can feel oily when it is warmer out but I did not get that feeling at all. I really enjoy vacation's products they smell great and are well thought out. Product was received as part of an educational promotion.

This is an amazing mineral sunscreen! It is so fun to apply, and easy too! It doesn't take much effort like other mineral sunscreens and leaves no white cast on me. I also love the packaging! Because this sunscreen is so lightweight, this package keeps it easy to use and mess free! Received as part of an educational promotion.

As a dad who's always on the move, Vacation's Shake Shake sunscreen has become one of my go-to essentials. The fliptop tube is a standout. It never leaks in my gym bag or diaper bag, which is a small detail that makes a huge difference. I also love the texture! It's very lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy. What really sold me, though, is how easy it is to use on my daughter. Compared to thicker, lotion based sunscreens, this one goes on smoothly without endless rubbing, which makes application faster and more comfortable for both of us. Overall, I highly recommend Vaction's Shake Shake for busy parents and anyone who needs an effective, mess-free sunscreen for life on the go. I absolutely love this sunscreen!

I recived this product for an educational promotion and tested this product for awhile. This sunscreen is my favorite, it lathered on my skin really nicely with no white cast, keeping my skin looking hyrated and dewy. Sunscreen did not crease with makeup on top and keeps my skin protected.

avis.titre: Lightweight Mineral Sunscreen That Actually Feels Great on S
avis.texte: I received this product as part of an educational promotion. I was really impressed by how lightweight this mineral sunscreen feels on the skin. It has a milky texture that blends in smoothly without leaving a heavy or chalky residue like most SPF 50 mineral formulas tend to do. I have combo skin, and it didn't cling to dry patches or make my T-zone oily throughout the day. What I love most is the finish; it's soft, natural, and not overly matte or greasy. It layers beautifully under makeup and doesn't pill, even when I use moisturizer and primer underneath. After wearing it for several days, I noticed that it didn't irritate my skin or cause breakouts, which is rare for mineral sunscreens.

I love the retro-style packaging of this brand (it's so cute), but the sunscreen inside feels modern to me! The product is very thin and blends easily for me - I have fair skin, but I do not notice a white cast on my skin when using this. It does have a noticeable scent, but I don't find it to be overpowering or unpleasant. The packing makes it easy to take on-the-go; I love being able to pop it in my bag on sunny days to reapply! I have acne-prone skin, and I don't notice increased break outs while using this SPF. I also love that this product contains hydrating ingredients, as I can skip an additional moisturizer when using this SPF in the morning! Overall, I would recommend it! I received a free product as part of an educational promotion, but all opinions are my own.

Face sunscreen is a must for me on the daily, I don't go one day without wearing it. Rain or shine, there will be sunscreen on my face! I was so excited to try the Vacation Shake Shake SPF 50 Mineral Milk Face Sunscreen. First of all, I love the fun and convenient packaging. I am able to apply it straight to my face as it dispenses the perfect amount onto my skin. Second, it's super lightweight and works really well with my makeup. It does feel a little greasy at first, however, that didn't impact how my makeup went on. There is no white cast which is such a big plus, as it is annoying when I have to rub in the sunscreen really well to remove it. It has a fresh like scent to it mixed with your typical sunscreen smell, I kinda like it. Overall, such a great face sunscreen with 50 SPF! received as a part of an educational promotion

Vacation Shake Shake SPF 50 Mineral Milk Facial Sunscreen makes wearing sunscreen comfy and not bothersome. The thin, milky consistency is easy to apply, absorbs fast, and feels comfortable on the skin. It's lightweight, not greasy or heavy at all. There's no white cast or pilling. It's perfect to use as is or layered under makeup. My face feels silky smooth and soft with a light glowy satin sheen. It does have a tropical scent that's not overwhelming. I also love how the sunscreen incorporates good-for-you skincare ingredients like hyaluronic acid, squalane, ceramides, and polypeptide to support the skin barrier and boost hydration. The packaging is super cute too. The colors and design look a bit retro. The thinner smaller bottle makes it sleek and easy to carry around. Overall, I'm impressed and will definitely be reaching for this sunscreen every day. I received this as a part of an educational promotion.

The product was received as part of an educational promotion. I have tried many sunscreens before, but I have never tried one like this. The component itself is very cute and gives me old vibes, but in a good, nostalgic way. I like how the top has a little flip component and clicks into place, so I know that if I were to take it while traveling, it would not just start leaking. When I wear sunscreen, I usually like to put it on my two fingers to kind of follow the two-finger rule. However, when I tried to do that with this sunscreen, I didn't realize how runny it was going to be. Therefore, after that, I go ahead and just drip it directly onto my face. As I said before, the sunscreen is very runny, but it's not bad; it actually helps it blend in a lot quicker and, for me, feels a lot lighter. I have combination skin that's also acne-prone, and I found this sunscreen did not break me out. Best of all, I feel like it gave me a satin matte finish and was not glowy like others, which I cannot stand. The scent was not one that I had smelled before; it wasn't bad, and it didn't linger, so it didn't bother me. Another good feature that I liked is that it did not sting my eyes. I can see myself reaching for this in the summer and even all year round, really. This is one that I would definitely repurchase once I finish it.

*received this product as an incentive* This has been a great sunscreen. I have sensitive skin and sensitivite eyes. I have been very picky about sunscreens. Do to them burning my eyes. This sunscreen does not burn! It is a very liquidy formula. Has a faint cucumber/fresh smell but does not have any added fragrance. This does not leave a white cast either. It blends in great and leaves the skin glowing. It also layers well under makeup. I will continue to reach for this!

The SPF 50 protection is great, and it goes on smoothly, but the formula is very liquid, so it can feel a bit messy to apply. Still, it absorbs well and doesn't leave a white cast—good for everyday use!

The sunscreen has a mild, lightly tropical smell. It goes on smoothly and sinks into my skin. It doesn't leave a white cast like other mineral sunscreens do, nor does it leave that heaviness or smothering feeling on your skin. It is non-drying and moisturizing and my somewhat sensitive skin had zero reaction to it. You could apply this sunscreen without a mirror that's how good it disappears and sinks into your skin. It is the perfect sunscreen to apply before makeup; a little bit goes a long way. After giving it a nice shake to mix the product, it comes out very thin and milky. You do have to tilt it just slightly to avoid getting more product than you may want. I appreciate the small, lightweight, no-drip bottle you can throw in your travel bag, purse, or beach bag to reapply throughout the day. I received this product as part of an educational promotion.

I've been in search of a sunscreen that i can wear everyday without clogging my pores, breaking me out or making me look like a ghost. While it does have a slight white cast, it does sink into the skin after a minute or two. I am fair skinned though. I received this as a part of an educational promotion, however, i can confidently say i would recommend this product after using it for about a week. I LOVE the way it feels on my skin, it's soft, velvety and silky smooth. 9/10 would purchase again

I loved how this formula was lightweight and blended relatively easily for a mineral version. I have the peace of mind that this product is not causing hormonal disruption while ensuring I have the anti-aging properties of a sunblock. There were also nourishing ingredients contrary to the usual formulas that helped my skin stay plump, hydrated, and moisturized. The container was also impeccable. One of the biggest problems with sunblock containers is that they squeeze out way too much at once so that you waste all your money on it. This squeezed out just a tad bit without causing excess grease and oil on your face from the sheer fact that the bottle put out more than you needed. All in all, I highly recommend this block as a well-rounded moisturizer, sunscreen, and nourishing anti-aging product for all skin types.

I've been using the Vacation Shake Shake SPF 50 Mineral Milk, and I really enjoy how lightweight and comfortable it feels on my skin. The milky texture blends in smoothly after shaking and absorbs quickly without feeling heavy or greasy. This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Beautiful milk texture, but slight white cast
avis.texte: This is a beautiful product with a very intuitive packaging. The boxe it came in was pretty cute. The texture is very milky and since it has zinc, it did leave a white cast, and I have light to medium skin so anyone darker it might leave a worse white cast, but the white cast was maintainable I guess or I could still use it. I did receive this product as part of a educational promotion. It would be nice if they had tents or they added some payment so that it would be easier for other people to use into that way would not affect the worth of the product.

I live in Florida, so using SPF every single day is a must for me. This sunscreen has a very lightweight, milky texture that spreads easily and absorbs well without leaving a white cast. It feels comfortable on the skin, doesn't feel heavy or greasy, and works perfectly for daily sun protection in the strong Florida sun.

This milk sunscreen is a complete game changer for my makeup routine. It works great under my makeup and its super lightweight. The milk aspect of this product also makes it super moisturizing! This is the best face sunscreen on the market, especially because it gives me 50 spf! I am definitely making this a non negotiable staple in my makeup kit. *received as a part of an educational promotion.*

This product is not worth it at all. There is zero blend so you'll end up with a chalky face. The smell is absolutely disgusting and so is the consistency. I love Vacation's other sunscreens but definitely not this one.

I've been using the Vacation Shake Shake SPF 50 and I'm honestly impressed. The watery-milk texture feels super lightweight and blends in easily without leaving white streaks. It layers well under makeup, doesn't pill, and feels comfortable on my skin all day. I also love that it's mineral, non-greasy, and gentle for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: I love the texture of this SPF
avis.texte: I received this SPF 50 Mineral Milk as part of an educational program, and it's quickly become one of my favorite daily SPFs. First of all, I love the refreshing scent, it feels clean and uplifting without being overpowering. The texture is incredibly smooth, absorbs easily into the skin, and doesn't leave any residue or white cast. It layers well under makeup and feels lightweight enough for everyday use. This has officially become part of my daily SPF routine.

avis.titre: I wanted to love this product!
avis.texte: Overall, mineral sunscreen still isnt properly formulated for dark and deeper skin tones. If you're applying the appropriate amount of sunscreen, it gave me a slight grayish purple tone. It felt amazing on the skin but it made me look ashy.

avis.titre: No white cast on dark skin, smells
avis.texte: Tried on my arm, no white cast. Color is around Fenty 470. Very lightweight. The smell?? Horrendous. Makes me nauseous! Very chemical mixed with wet, fresh seaweed. Mineral sunscreens that work on my skin tone are so hard to find, I think ill still keep it to use on my lower body and use perfum to mask. Its also extremely lightweight.

avis.titre: NOT for oily and/or acne prone skin
avis.texte: Fun sunscreen, but made me breakout and exacerbated fungal acne! 😭 My bad for not reading the ingredients! Most reviews stated a smell which I personally didn't mind. There's better options out there for us oily gorls

This was an unexpected find. I'm always looking for a non tinted mineral sunscreen that's budge friendly, not too dry, doesn't peel, spreads easily, and doesn't leave white cast. I have a mineral sunscreen from Paula's choice that fits the bill but it's tinted and I do use it and like it still, but sometimes I want to see my natural skin color and not the sunscreen's tint! Anyway, super happy with this. I use a serum under it and don't need moisturizer. Hopefully they won't mess around with the formula.

avis.titre: One of the best mineral sunscreens I've tried!
avis.texte: Big fan of Vacation as a brand and this one is a winner. I love that this is easy to mix with my face moisturizer, and soaks in very easily with no opaqueness like other mineral sunscreens. My one little nag is that the pour nozzle is a little messy but I can deal lol
